# Capabilities

Every capability a plugin can be granted, and the functions of the plugin world each one grants. **Deny by default** (`NOCTUA.md §11.3`): a plugin's manifest lists the capabilities it asks for, and every function of a capability it was not granted answers `denied` — a value the plugin reads and goes on from, never a trap — so a plugin learns its limits by being told no.

Every function the world imports is on this page exactly once, under a capability or in an interface given to every plugin: `crates/nc-kernel/tests/capabilities.rs` reads the world with its own parser and holds this list to it in both directions. A resource's method is written as the parser names it, `[method]<resource>.<name>`, and is reachable only through the function that hands out the resource, which answers to the same capability.

## Granted on request

| Capability | Interface | Functions | en | pt-BR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blobs.read` | `blobs` | `locate`, `open`, `[method]reader.size`, `[method]reader.read`, `[method]reader.seek` | Find files by their content and read them, without loading a whole file into memory. | Encontrar arquivos pelo conteúdo e lê-los, sem carregar um arquivo inteiro na memória. |
| `blobs.write` | `blobs` | `create`, `announce`, `[method]writer.write`, `[method]writer.finish` | Save new files, and tell other devices that this one has them. | Salvar arquivos novos e avisar outros dispositivos de que este os tem. |
| `commands.begin` | `commands` | `begin`, `[method]unit.compensate-with`, `[method]unit.commit`, `[method]unit.abort` | Group several changes into one step that is kept whole or not at all, and undone as one. | Agrupar várias alterações em um só passo, mantido inteiro ou descartado, e desfeito de uma vez. |
| `commands.dispatch` | `commands` | `dispatch` | Ask other parts of Noctua to run their commands, each checked as if a person had asked. | Pedir a outras partes do Noctua que executem seus comandos, cada um verificado como se uma pessoa tivesse pedido. |
| `context` | `context` | `principal`, `actor-chain`, `confirmed-by-human` | Know who it is acting for: the person, anyone acting on their behalf, and whether a person confirmed this step. | Saber em nome de quem está agindo: a pessoa, quem age por ela e se uma pessoa confirmou este passo. |
| `events.publish` | `events` | `publish` | Announce that something happened, for other parts of Noctua to hear. | Anunciar que algo aconteceu, para outras partes do Noctua ficarem sabendo. |
| `events.subscribe` | `events` | none — it grants a declaration, not a call | Hear the announcements it names, and only those. | Ficar sabendo dos anúncios que indica, e somente desses. |
| `net` | `net` | `fetch` | Reach the websites it names, and no others. | Acessar os sites que indica, e nenhum outro. |
| `store` | `store` | `get`, `put`, `delete`, `list` | Keep structured data of its own, which no other part of Noctua can read or change. | Guardar dados estruturados próprios, que nenhuma outra parte do Noctua consegue ler ou alterar. |
| `timers` | `timers` | `after`, `every`, `cancel` | Be woken after a while, or at a regular interval. | Ser acordado depois de um tempo, ou em intervalos regulares. |
| `ui` | `ui` | `open-surface`, `close-surface`, `render` | Describe what it shows on screen, for Noctua to draw. | Descrever o que mostra na tela, para o Noctua desenhar. |

## Given to every plugin

| Interface | Functions | Why no manifest is asked |
|---|---|---|
| `log` | `write` | A line a plugin writes goes to that plugin's own bounded ring in the kernel and never reaches the central log (NOCTUA.md §15.4), so writing one tells nobody anything the plugin could not already see. `write` returns nothing, so there is no `denied` it could answer either. |
| `types` | none | It declares the types the other interfaces share and no function at all, so there is nothing in it to call. |
